title: tna-total-nonstop-action-2008-world
label: Christian Cage

won.source: The fed's World title banner (worldcage.png, uploaded 12 July 2008 to the federation's live member directory on the fwrestling.com hub, read in place on 6 October 2026; shown on its champions page from its capture of 13 July 2008) reads 'TNA WORLD CHAMPION / Christian Cage since 12/18/07'.

how: The fed's news of 10 February 2008 asks 'Can Tomko defend his boss Christian Cage's championship gold?', the Victory Road card of 13 July 2008 bills him (c) and Hard Justice (10 August 2008) heads its result 'STILL TNA World Heavyweight Champion, Christian Cage'; the fed's news of 24 January 2008 says all the TNA championships were decided on its opening show, so he won it in January 2008. No page held says on what night.
note: The banner's date is the federation's own later statement: its news of 17 and 24 January 2008 has every TNA title decided on its opening iMPACT! of 10 January 2008. The news of 10 February 2008, the Victory Road card (13 July 2008, 'Christian Cage (c)') and Hard Justice (10 August 2008, 'STILL TNA World Heavyweight Champion') carry the reign on.

title: tna-total-nonstop-action-2008-knockout
label: Karen Styles

won.source: The fed's champions page, in its capture of 31 July 2008, shows a Knockout title image file named knockoutkstyles; the file itself is not held. Its banner of 13 to 22 July reads 'Undecided since 06/26/08', and its news of 17 July 2008 reports Karen Angle and Kelly Kelly meeting for the vacant title, so the reign began between 17 and 31 July 2008.

how: Known from the file name of the Knockout title image on the fed's champions page of 31 July 2008 (knockoutkstyles); no served page bills the reign. The roster of 21 July 2008 puts Karen Styles in the place Karen Angle held the day before.
